correctness.rationale: On 7 nonempty occupancy masks of the path 1–2–3, death rates 1 except one distinguished q>0 and directed recolonization intensity λ per occupied neighbor define a transient Q_v. Starting from 111, F_v(z)=e_7^T(zI−Q_v)^{-1}1=N_v/D_v. All nonempty states can reach 000 by deaths, so for z≥0 each zI−Q_v is a nonsingular M-matrix with positive determinant. Independently built the exact 7×7 matrices and calculated 4 determinants with a direct finite signed-permutation expansion, distinct from the saved subset-DP checker. The cross numerator factors exactly λq(1−q)H(λ,q,z), with 159 positive integer terms, min=2, max=19670, total degree ≤8; the exact coefficient identity, not an experiment at points, proves the continuum sign. Independently solved scalar rational instances λ=1,q=1/2,z=0 yielding 851/182 vs 1599/370; z=1 yielding 1307/1480 vs 48135/54809; plus λ=2/3,q=3/4,z=3/5. For q=1 symmetry and λ=0 independent lifetimes give equality. z=0 is mean survival time and positive z Laplace ordering. No deterministic-time stochastic dominance is implied.

originality.rationale: A permanent single-patch heterogeneous extinction-hazard placement comparison with one strict sign for ALL discounts z≥0 is more specific than existing mean-extinction management recommendations. The full Chadès et al PNAS article investigates sequential controlled network management, not the fixed no-control placement of q in a 7-state CTMC. Etienne–Heesterbeek (2001) explicitly recommend connected patches when baseline hazards nearly coincide, so center-favors-mean is NOT novel and its full article could conceal a stronger result; it was not retrieved even through authorized access (vpn_disconnected). Neither the inspected abstracts nor the accessible full paper establish a general all-z Laplace-transform order. Best of knowledge qualified, not absence-of-search proof.

value.rationale: An all-discount ordering is a substantive structural comparison for stochastic persistence, as distinct planning horizons lead to different integrated/discounted objectives. It sharpens a qualitative mean-persistence rule into an exact theorem with strictness, equality and reversal regimes on a natural minimal recolonizing path, not a numerical example. Limitation: it is only three patches initially all occupied, not fixed-time stochastic dominance or landscape-wide management policy.
